description: Defines abstract classes and interfaces for managing vertex buffers in a graphics API-agnostic manner, specifically for Direct3D rendering within ANGLE project.

classes.name: VertexBuffer
classes.description: Abstract base class for vertex buffer objects with reference counting and serial management.

classes.name: VertexBufferInterface
classes.description: Interface for managing vertex buffer memory, associated with a BufferFactoryD3D.

classes.name: StreamingVertexBufferInterface
classes.description: Derived class for handling dynamic (streaming) vertex buffers.

classes.name: StaticVertexBufferInterface
classes.description: Derived class for handling static vertex buffers with attribute matching.

classes.name: AttributeSignature
classes.description: Helper class for matching and setting attribute signatures in static buffers.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the vertex buffer with a given size and usage pattern.

methods.name: storeVertexAttributes
methods.description: Stores vertex attribute data into the buffer.

methods.name: setBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the buffer.

methods.name: getSpaceRequired
methods.description: Calculates space needed for vertex attributes.

methods.name: storeStaticAttribute
methods.description: Stores static attribute data into the buffer.

methods.name: matchesAttribute
methods.description: Checks if the attribute matches the stored signature.
